attributes.magic: PE32 executable (GUI) Intel 80386, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The binary is a malicious loader designed to execute an HTML Application (HTA). It first checks for script execution restrictions by calling `WldpGetLockdownPolicy`. It then locates `mshtml.dll` by querying the registry for the `Shell.Explorer` COM object path (CLSID `{25336920-03f9-11cf-8fd0-...}`). Finally, it dynamically loads `mshtml.dll` and calls the exported function `RunHTMLApplication`, a common technique to execute malicious VBScript or JScript payloads without directly invoking `mshta.exe`.
